name: PP3
critical_points_format: [distance, point, cutType, index into getCuts(polygon) (-1 for NONE), path segment index, perturbed sample point = purturbPointAlongSeg(point, seg, purturb, far=true), getPhysicalGaps(polygon, sample) as [startEdge,endEdge,startPoint,endPoint]]

get_gaps.sets_format: t = gaps[0].relativeTime; sample_index = critical point whose sample (perturbed point) this set is: its gaps are, in the same order, exactly getPhysicalGaps at that sample (sets_equal_samples); gaps: [id, iEdge, toGapSet in Java HashSet iteration order]; line = ProjectPanel/ProjectPanel5 stdout line: Double.toString(relativeTime) + ' ' + each Gap.toString() + ' '

nse.states_format: one string per gap set, one char per gap in set order: 0 = CLEAR, 1 = CONTAMINATED, - = null
nse.lines_note: ProjectPanel2/3 print each set as Gap.toString() + ' ' per gap, where toString inserts '| 0' (clear) or '| 1' (contaminated) after the iEdge

oracle_runs.events_format: [relativeTime, type, fromGap, toGap, movedAgents, visibleAgents, toString()] in TreeMap (time) order
oracle_runs.truth_final_format: number of targets the oracle put in each final gap, aligned with get_gaps.final_ids
